thread:
Noah Lee: Heads up - Customer Vertex raised a billing gap for April embeddings. They sent a short sample and say ~9% of embedding requests are missing from invoice.
Priya Shah: Thanks, Noah. Any region/plan details?
Noah Lee: us-central, on committed tier. They sent 5 sample request_ids and timestamps.
Lucas Meyer: I ran a quick diff between exporter counts and invoice lines. There's a cluster of events around 2026-04-05 11:00-11:45Z with many 'resend' annotations in exporter logs.
Priya Shah: Can you paste the log snippet?
Lucas Meyer: Sure:

```
2026-04-05T11:12:03Z exporter: request_id=rdx-77 status=served resend=true original_id=rdx-3f
2026-04-05T11:12:03Z exporter: request_id=rdx-77 metering_id=mt-559
```

Metering ingesters appear to insert events using request_id but our dedupe key only considered metering_id in that codepath.
billing-bot: Alert: 430 requests for customer_vertex between 2026-04-05T11:00Z and 2026-04-05T12:00Z flagged as SERVED_NOT_BILLABLE (reason: resend_unmapped).
Noah Lee: That's consistent with their samples. What is the token impact?
Priya Shah: Running a quick aggregate now.
Priya Shah: SQL used:
```
SELECT SUM(tokens) FROM metering_events WHERE customer_id='customer_vertex' AND reason='resend_unmapped' AND event_time BETWEEN '2026-04-05' AND '2026-04-05 12:00';
```
Result ~640k embedding tokens. Estimated invoice delta $350 list / $230 committed.
Lucas Meyer: Backfill plan: join exporter original_id -> metering events where metering_id differs, reassign reason -> attributed, then write to invoice_candidates table for review. Dry-run only.
Noah Lee: Any chance of double-billing?
Priya Shah: We will gate on invoice_lines absence and event current state == SERVED_NOT_BILLABLE. We'll also compute checksum before applying. Dry-run will produce CSV and row counts.
billing-bot: Task scheduled: backfill-dryrun/vertex/1802233445 (ETA 2026-04-10T02:00Z)
CS-Triage: Looping in Customer Success to notify Vertex proactively if we adjust invoice.
Noah Lee: Approve dry-run. Please include the sample request_ids Vertex provided to validate mapping.
Lucas Meyer: Will do. Also pushing a quick fix to exporter so resend events include original_request_id in the metering payload. Canary deploy in eu-west-1 later today.
Priya Shah: After dry-run I'll post the CSV and counts: candidate_rows, tokens_total, invoice_delta. If delta differs >20% from estimate, we'll hold and escalate.
Noah Lee: Good. Small note for finance ops: if dry-run looks clean, I'd prefer automated backfill instead of manual credit. It keeps audit trail tidy.
Priya Shah: Agreed. Dry-run output will include audit tags and migration id.
Noah Lee: Thanks everyone. Please keep this thread updated with dry-run CSV and approval step. :pray:
billing-bot: Dry-run completed (2026-04-10T02:17Z). CSV uploaded to s3://redwood-backfills/vertex/1802233445-dryrun.csv
Priya Shah: Dry-run results: candidate_rows=431, tokens=642128, estimated_invoice_delta=$228 (committed). Checksums match expected. Posting CSV link.
Noah Lee: Looks within expected range. Approving full run.
CS-Triage: Noted. Preparing customer note template.
billing-bot: Backfill job started 2026-04-11T03:10Z. Migration tag: reconciliation/vertex/1802233445.
Priya Shah: Backfill finished. Applied token adjustments to ledger, created credit memo CM-44521 for $228. Audit log saved.
Noah Lee: Thanks team. Follow-up: confirm exporter patch deployed and add automated alert for resend_unmapped > 10/min.
Lucas Meyer: Will roll patch across clusters and add alert.
